meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: Runs rigorous visual QA across web, terminal, and paginated surfaces with screenshot evidence and a verdict. Use for any UI build or change, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 跑一次视觉核对,用截图确认界面改动是否正常。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次改完界面都要靠肉眼反复确认有没有走样。
copy.tagline_en: Check any UI change with screenshots and get a clear pass-or-fail verdict.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep eyeballing every UI change to make sure nothing broke.

howto.what: Claude 会对它构建或改动过的界面做视觉 QA：截取网页、终端 TUI 或分页文档的画面取证，用脚本比对，再派两个只读子代理复核，最后给出通过/返修/失败判定。
howto.when: 当你构建或改动任意 UI、准备宣布完成之前，或询问某个页面/TUI 看起来对不对时触发；输出需匹配基线、怀疑出现回归时也用。

say.text: 帮我给这个页面做视觉 QA
say.note: 会截图取证并派两个子代理复核，给出判定

say.text: 这个 TUI 布局对不对，跑一下 visual-qa
say.note: 会捕获终端画面并检查宽度与边框

say.text: 把这份 PDF 每一页都截图检查排版
say.note: 逐页渲染成图片核对，不靠文本提取

howto.what_en: Claude visually QAs any UI it builds or changes: it captures screenshots of web pages, terminal TUIs, or paginated documents as evidence, runs script comparisons, sends two read-only subagent reviews, and returns a pass/revise/fail verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers after you build or change any UI, before calling it done, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right; also when output must match a baseline or a regression is suspected.

say_en.text: Run visual QA on this page for me
say_en.note: Captures screenshots, dispatches two reviewers, returns a verdict

say_en.text: Check this TUI layout with visual-qa
say_en.note: Captures the terminal render, checks width and borders

say_en.text: Screenshot every page of this PDF to check layout
say_en.note: Renders each page to an image instead of extracting text
